intent: Continue the Bominal-grade cohesive Oyatie dashboard by upgrading FinOps, Resource Inventory, Evidence Ledger, and Object Graph direct anchors into interactive FD-001/Oyatie Cloud trust proof surfaces with SSR parity.
product_direction: Oyatie will build a hyperscaler-grade cloud substrate and dogfood all FD-001 microservices as tenant workloads on that substrate. FD-001 product delivery remains the master-plan product goal; Oyatie Cloud is the substrate that proves the platform can host real production tenants.
implementation_summary: Added dynamic and SSR-static trust proof boards to FinOps, Resource Inventory, Evidence Ledger, and Object Graph using the existing proof-card visual language.
Each direct anchor now states FD-001 product delivery, Oyatie Cloud dogfood substrate posture, and explicit local-only/no-mutation boundaries instead of reading as a separate isolated widget.

Added data-trust-proof-action routing/staging interactions for budget guardrails, receipt sealing, resource linking, lineage tracing, and routes to Cloud, Policy, Inventory, Audit, Gates, Evidence, Workflow, Finance, Mail, Messenger, Community, and Catalog.
Added reusable trust-anchor CSS and responsive grid handling without introducing a separate design-system layer.

interaction_assertions.status: Budget guardrail staged locally · no billing, procurement, deploy, DNS, or cloud mutation

visual_verdict.category_match: Cohesive FD-001/Oyatie Cloud trust, cost, resource, evidence, and graph command surfaces
visual_verdict.reasoning: The four sparse direct anchors now carry the same product thesis: FD-001 remains the product delivery goal, Oyatie Cloud is the substrate, and every control is visually interactive but local-only. Metrics confirm each target has proof cards/actions/statuses and direct FD-001/Oyatie Cloud/local-boundary language; Playwright confirms core route and staging interactions work in the live Podman browser session.
differences: The added proof boards increase vertical density; this is an intentional content and affordance addition, not a regression.
No external backend is wired; the mock remains explicit about no billing, deploy, mail, database, or cloud mutation.
suggestions: Continue remaining sparse direct anchors such as ledger preview, filing readiness, and service catalog in later slices.
After the remaining anchors converge, consolidate repeated proof-board patterns into a smaller shared component/token layer.

commands.summary: ready-after-4s; transient empty replies immediately after restart

known_limits: Visual prototype only; no backend writes, auth changes, workflow execution, mail sends, billing, deploy, DNS, database, provider, or cloud mutations are wired.
This slice improves FinOps, Resource Inventory, Evidence Ledger, and Object Graph; it does not prove the full dashboard/mockup objective complete.
